calibration: none: a vote count, not a fitted probability. Its probability is the share of the three voters (two_part_gbm, ngboost_laplace, hierarchical_logistic) whose own flag is up that day, and its flag is two of three, so its cut-off is 2/3 by construction. Each voter's flag is the judge's own, at the cut-off chosen refit by refit from that voter's training window (pressure_judge.choose_cutoffs); the vote has no cut-off of its own to choose. Existing walk-forward forecasts, no refit (scripts/vote_2_of_3.py)
